en.Your name, work email address, team memb: Your name, work email address, team membership, profile avatar, and authentication credentials. Passwords are encrypted with salted one-way hashes; OAuth sign-ins store zero password data.
en.Inbound and outbound messages sent throu: Inbound and outbound messages sent through the Elpino chat widget, connected inboxes, visitor profile tags (name, email submitted by visitor), thread status, handoff logs, and conversation attachments.
en.Help center articles, FAQs, uploaded pol: Help center articles, FAQs, uploaded policy documents, macros, canned responses, and custom instructions you configure to ground the AI in your company's verified knowledge.
en.When you link connectors (Google, Slack,: When you link connectors (Google, Slack, Stripe, Razorpay, etc.), we access only the specific scopes you authorize (e.g., payment status verification or notification dispatch).
en.AI resolution counts, token usage, laten: AI resolution counts, token usage, latency metrics, handoff trigger rates, system audit logs, and security telemetry needed for billing, rate limits, and abuse prevention.
en.Handled securely via our PCI-DSS certifi: Handled securely via our PCI-DSS certified payment processor (Razorpay). Elpino never sees or stores full credit card numbers; we retain only subscription tier, billing period, and invoice identifiers.
en.We use data to run Elpino for you: answe: We use data to run Elpino for you: answering, handing off, drafting, sorting and metering. No selling, no ads, no credit decisions, no public model training.
en.We process workspace and customer inform: We process workspace and customer information exclusively to deliver, maintain, and secure the Elpino platform:
en.Synthesizing immediate, grounded answers: Synthesizing immediate, grounded answers to visitor queries based strictly on your uploaded knowledge base and approved canned macros.
